nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: TikTok Intelligence FM: product Search API.

category.description: For English category names, the system automatically matches the TikTok category ID; non-English names need to be translated into English first.

creatorCountRange.description: Filter the number of people carrying goods, format: `{"min": 10, "max": 500}`.

isLocalWarehouse.description: Only filter products shipped from local warehouses.

isSshop.description: Filter only TikTok fully hosted (S-shop) items.

keyword.description: Search keywords (fuzzy matching of product titles).

orderField.description: Sorting fields: `day7_units_sold` (7-day sales), `day7_gmv` (7-day GMV), `commission_rate` (commission rate), `total_units_sold` (total sales), `total_gmv` (total GMV), `creator_count` (number of customers). Default is descending order.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page, maximum `10`.

region.description: Market area code. Optional values: `US` (United States), `GB` (UK), `MX` (Mexico), `ES` (Spain), `DE` (Germany), `IT` (Italy), `FR` (France), `ID` (Indonesia), `VN` (Vietnam), `MY` (Malaysia), `TH` (Thailand), `PH` (Philippines), `BR` (Brazil), `JP` (Japan), `SG` (Singapore).
